title: Privacy Notice
intro: How we handle your email and account data on CosmicTrack.

collect.title: What we collect
collect.item1: Email address (required for login/register and account recovery).
collect.item2: Basic profile data you provide (e.g., name, avatar).
collect.item3: Usage data you create in the app (journeys, steps, categories, favorites).

why.title: Why we collect it
why.item1: Authenticate you and secure your account.
why.item2: Sync your journeys and categories across devices.
why.item3: Send essential account emails (confirmation, reset, security).

dosAndDonts.title: What we do
dosAndDonts.item1: No selling or sharing emails with third parties for marketing.
dosAndDonts.item2: No marketing emails without your explicit opt-in.
dosAndDonts.item3: We use Supabase as our backend; data is stored and secured there.

choices.title: Your choices
choices.item1: Delete your account in Profile to remove your data from our systems.
choices.item2: Update your journeys and account info anytime in the app.
